verdict.rationale: Adyen documents an official MCP server enabling natural-language interaction with its APIs (sessions, payment links, refunds, management API tools) via a standard LLM client, with scoped API-credential roles, plus llms.txt/markdown docs for AI-tool integration. However, the MCP server is explicitly labeled 'Alpha' and all evidence is first-party vendor documentation with no independent/hands-on corroboration of real-world natural-language operation. Missing for 10: independent or community validation of the MCP server in practice, and confirmation it has moved beyond alpha/experimental status.
